At Total Family Solutions, our team is our greatest asset. We’re seeking enthusiastic, compassionate professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional care across New Jersey.

We have openings for Intensive In-Community therapists (LPC, LCSW) across multiple counties, offering flexible, mission-driven work with youth and families in their homes.

Our Outpatient Therapist positions (LAC, LPC, LSW, LCSW, LAMFT) require at least one year of experience with youth in outpatient or in-home settings and familiarity with short-term, solution-focused modalities. Flexible scheduling available.

Join us in supporting and strengthening the communities we serve.

Total Family Solutions offers clinical internship placements for students looking to gain hands-on experience in a supportive, client-centered environment. Our interns work alongside experienced clinicians, learning short-term, solution-focused approaches while supporting children, teens, adults, and families across New Jersey.

To be considered for a clinical internship position, please complete the application and email it to our Human Resources department: Lola Riddle – lriddle@totalfamilysolutions.com. We welcome motivated, compassionate students who are committed to professional growth and making a positive difference in the community.
